arguments.report:
# Plan r3 — #104 Establish portable npm identity and license posture

Plan r2 remains in force with exactly one deletion: delete the stale r1 Risks / non-guess rules row `Copyright legal name unspecified | Use public repo owner + year; no invented company string`. This removes the unauthorized copyright presumption and aligns the risk table with r2 §1, which forbids adding or inferring a copyright holder/year. Nothing else changes.

## Surviving Risks / non-guess rules

| Risk | Handling |
| --- | --- |
| No npm auth | Cannot claim publishability; AC1 unfinished/refused with `ENEEDAUTH` evidence; do not rename on vibes |
| `@ak` org does not exist / no rights | Use authenticated fallback order; document |
| Pi docs say peer `*` | Ticket + Finding 4 override; document, don’t expand scope to upstream Pi |
| Skill snapshots absent | Notice posture only; bodies stay #109+ |
| `files` / pack drift | Explicitly include LICENSE + notice; assert via shared pack fixture |
| Missing worktree `node_modules` | `npm install` first thing in apply |

All other r1 provisions retained by r2, and all three r2 revisions, remain unchanged.
